text_blocks.text: It was reports in the paper that he was a little too vocal. A lot of people say Chris Paul's alpha male can kick in and rub people the wrong way. text_blocks.text: Sometimes being a leader is lonely. I would say that. How many times when you leading any group of people, everybody going to agree with your shit? So with me, we have a relationship where we can be honest and open with each other and those are the relationships that usually grow. So it ain't no thing if you don't like the truth. And he's not one of them people that you can't tell him things about himself.
